topic: What should I verify before applying for a scholarship?
disclaimer: This tool identifies potential information gaps, variances, and outdated signals based solely on the provided sources. It does not establish absolute truth or absence. Always confirm critical terms with the official governing body.

checklist.label: Eligibility Criteria
checklist.why: Missing eligibility details can lead to wasted effort on applications you cannot receive.

checklist.label: Application Deadline
checklist.why: Missing the deadline means your application will be rejected outright.

checklist.label: Required Documents
checklist.why: Incomplete documentation results in an incomplete application and possible disqualification.

checklist.label: GPA Requirements
checklist.why: Not meeting GPA thresholds can cause automatic rejection.

checklist.label: Essay Prompt
checklist.why: Misunderstanding the prompt can produce an irrelevant essay and lower your chances.

checklist.label: Recommendation Letters
checklist.why: Insufficient or inappropriate references can weaken your application.

checklist.label: Award Amount
checklist.why: Knowing the amount helps you assess whether the scholarship meets your financial needs.

checklist.label: Renewal Requirements
checklist.why: Failing to meet renewal criteria can cause loss of funding after the first year.

checklist.label: Selection Process
checklist.why: Understanding how candidates are evaluated lets you tailor your application effectively.

checklist.label: Tax Implications
checklist.why: Overlooking tax responsibilities can lead to unexpected financial liabilities.
